title: Difficult to use in iphone
body: I thought I paid for the ipad version. Once I paid, it was for iphone ONLY. And I had to pay double to use it in ipad. In iphone it is so difficult to see my categories. I am not pleased at all.

title: Still trying it out
body: I’m about a week and still trying to see if it will work for my adhd- I like the fact that the interface is easy to navigate so getting started is super easy. It would be great if it would add the to do to your calendar but still working it all out so will see how it goes
author: staceyvermaak

title: Best thing ever
body: Great app to get things done. Anything!
author: MacReza

title: In a leugue of it's own
body:
I'm annoyed having taken this long to move over to Things 3. I've been using multiple other options far too long.
The power is tucked away superbly in it's simplicity. After spending almost a day brining entries from other platforms, this mor ING was 1st morning of "Today" view - superbly well done. The term "Today" is misleading in relation to what many others call the same.
In Things 3 the tranquillity provided is unmatched - Today's items nicely reflected per Area and project - just Awesomeness!!
Don't wait - you're merely treading water elsewhere, make the investment, reap the rewards
author: Silver~2023

title: I’m rather upset it took me so long to switch
body: I know why though, OF satisfied my curious mind for complexity but I’d *suffer* later as I would sometimes not bloody use the app at all. Also, I wanted to make it work because of the investment. But I finally accepted that I was on the wrong road for me and my peculiarities. Things 3 was the answer all a long. It is the perfect combination of, I suspect a lot of elements. Almost like a lot of psychology went into it, too. If very effectively hides busyness and just gives me what I need. In the end the double, triple money I spent to get here does not compare to the win I feel daily. This is a great thing you built.
author: aJEFFreview

title: It’s really Impressive
body: I have tried so many to do apps. This is it.
author: RobertdeRooy

title: Very different from things 2
body: Great app does what it says it does and not all developers get that right. Definitely recommend this to anyone that needs  GTD app. Things 3 is one of the best. If you have been looking for something easy to use and not forget things, this is the app for you.
author: DarkDragonUS

title: Things is now seamlessly coordinating my life for me
body: This app is so simple and phenomenal. It has helped clear my mind of clutter and has taken over my physical diary. No more wasted time rewriting task lists, it’s so quick to reorganize a project or add a quick thought. What I love the most is future-dated reminders. Things is now my diary and project manager for work, home, kids, and personal life.

title: Great but one problem
body: The app is great and flows well but one problem is persistent: notifications for reminders that I’ve set on the app don’t present themselves. It gets really annoying when I get to the end of the week only to find that I’ve forgotten a few tasks I wanted to be reminded of. Please try fix it. It’s the only problem I find.

author: Warrick Jubber

title: Simple to use yet very effective
body:
I have stopped my subscription of the ToDo Cloud app after being with them for 3 years as the program stopped working correctly and after reporting the issues. 

THINGS is faster and easier to use and more effective with their tags during cross reference of To do items than ToDo Cloud. 

I did a lot of research on Wunderlist and Todoist and I am not impressed. 

If THINGS maintain there very high and efficient standards I am sure I will be with them for many a year.
author: Niveus Vendo

title: Great tool to organize work and personal life
body: Does an excellent job to help organize personal and work projects with tasks and reminders etc.
author: asmuts

title: The upgrade is well worth it!
body: Things is a very effective app to keep on top of tasks, from larger projects which can be broken down into smaller tasks, to reminders on small tasks. It helps with types of tasks, work vs personal. You can choose to schedule timing, or not, train a less structured approach. The new interface is a visual upgrade - great step forward. So now we can enjoy functionality combined with a pleasant, user-friendly interface. The one annoying feature is that you need to purchase for each device.
author: Zinno/za
